text.text: 100G Transponder with CPAK Client Interface

graphic.text: 100G Transponder with CPAK Client Interface

text.text: The 100G transponder/trunk features Cisco's 100G CP-DQPSK DWDM module employing nLight Silicon, allowing for unregenerated distances of up to 4800 km. By integrating a Cisco CPAK client port on the same card, a 100G transponder with SR-10 or LR-4 interface occupies only a single slot, equating to one transponder per rack unit, or 42 per bay.

text.text: Optical Encryption Line Card

graphic.text: Optical Encryption Line Card

text.text: The 10G Optical Encryption Line Card brings secure transport capability to DWDM networks. The card provides data confidentiality and data integrity through the combination of next-generation cryptography and trusted product architecture. Consisting of ten SFP+ ports in five pairs, the line card provides integrated transponder functionality in addition to encryption.

text.text: 16 Port Flex Spectrum ROADM

graphic.text: 16 Port Flex Spectrum ROADM

text.text: The 16-Port FlexSpectrum ROADM Line Card provides multi-degree switching capabilities not only at the individual wavelength level but also with flexible spectrum allocations. It creates an agile DWDM layer forming the foundation for converged transport architectures, delivering many features and innovations that enable significant provisioning and recovery flexibility. Wavelength routing, including direction and frequency changes, are entirely software-driven, easing one of the major contributors to high OpEx and long provisioning and recovery delays caused by manual operator intervention.

text.text: Erbium Doped Raman Amplifier

graphic.text: Erbium Doped Raman Amplifier

text.text: The Cisco NCS 2000 introduces hybrid Raman-EDFA amplifiers known as erbium doped Raman amplifiers, or EDRAs. EDRAs support an ultra-low noise figure critical for long distance, high bit rate transmission. Supporting 96 channels in the C-band, Cisco NCS 2000 Erbium Doped Raman Amplifiers provide the reach and optical performance required to meet the most demanding distance requirements of ultra long haul DWDM networks.
